name: Wan2.2 TI2V 5B
description: Image-to-video model extension for Wan2.2 TI2V 5B. Setup prepares the Python runtime only; model weights are downloaded later from the Modly Models UI.
author: DrHepa

metadata.surface_owner: FastAPI model extension; reusable workflow video preview node is declared by this extension through Modly workflow_nodes and rendered by Modly using an allowlisted host component
metadata.runtime_policy: vendored Wan runtime; setup.py never clones Wan
metadata.workflow_node_policy: provides singleton modly.workflow.preview.video so future video extensions can reuse/dedupe the player node
metadata.thermal_default_policy: defaults favor safer first runs on sustained GPU workloads; increase frames/steps only after validating thermals

licensing.model_weights: Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face model card for Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B

setup.log_policy: setup.py writes plain stdout/stderr lines; Modly forwards them to install progress

nodes.name: Image to Video
nodes.description: Generates a 24 FPS MP4 video from an input image and text prompt using Wan2.2 TI2V 5B.

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.default: A cinematic shot with subtle camera motion, detailed lighting, and smooth natural movement.
params_schema.tooltip: Positive motion/video prompt. This is required for Wan TI2V generation.

params_schema.label: Negative Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Optional negative prompt. Leave empty to use Wan's default negative prompt.

params_schema.label: Orientation
params_schema.tooltip: Auto preserves the input orientation; fixed modes crop the input to the chosen video aspect.

params_schema.label: Frames
params_schema.tooltip: Wan requires frame counts in the form 4n+1. 81 is safer for first runs; 121 gives about 5 seconds at 24 FPS.

params_schema.label: Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Diffusion sampling steps. 20 is safer for first runs on thermally constrained systems; higher is slower and may improve quality.

workflow_nodes.name: Preview Video
workflow_nodes.description: Preview a generated video artifact in the workflow canvas.
